note: 19 hook formulas for X. The first line is most of the post: write it so it works alone. Templates and examples are illustrative and invented. Replace every {slot} with something true and specific, or output {{your number}} and ask. 'match' is a regex swipe.py uses to name the formula a captured post used.
rules: Numbers beat adjectives, but only numbers you can stand behind.
If it works with any other account's name on it, it is not your hook.
No hashtags, no emoji strings, no engagement bait in line 1.
Never ask for likes or reposts. It is bait, and bait is also an Original Content Rewards ineligibility problem.

hooks.name: Contrarian Take
hooks.template: Everyone says {common advice}. {specific experience} says otherwise.
hooks.example: Everyone says post daily. I posted 4 times a week for a year and my replies went up.
hooks.best_for: A real point of view. Draws replies, which carry the heaviest engagement weight.

hooks.name: Number Reveal
hooks.example: 400 cold DMs in 30 days. 11 replies. 2 clients.
hooks.trap: A number that is rounded, invented or not yours.

hooks.name: Mistake Confession
hooks.template: I {did the wrong thing} for {time}. It cost me {cost}.
hooks.example: I underpriced for 8 months. It cost me about $12,000.
hooks.best_for: Trust. Specific cost makes it believable.
hooks.trap: A humble-brag where the mistake was secretly a win.

hooks.name: Before After
hooks.template: {Before state}. Then I changed {one thing}. {After state}.
hooks.example: 3 clients in a year. Then I changed my bio. 3 in a month.
hooks.best_for: One clear change with a visible delta.
hooks.trap: Changing five things and crediting one.

hooks.name: Myth Kill
hooks.template: "{Belief}" is wrong. Here is what the data shows.
hooks.example: "Links kill reach" is half true. Here is what I see.
hooks.best_for: Correcting a belief your audience holds.

hooks.name: Specific List
hooks.example: 5 questions I ask before taking any freelance call:
hooks.best_for: Saveable lists with a promised payoff.

hooks.name: Plain Observation
hooks.example: Every client who ghosted me skipped the same question.
hooks.best_for: Low-ego posts that invite a reply with the reader's own example.

hooks.name: Question From Experience
hooks.template: {Specific question only someone in this spot would ask}?
hooks.example: Freelancers: do you quote before or after the discovery call?
hooks.best_for: Replies. The question must be answerable in one line.
hooks.trap: A question with no stake, such as "thoughts?".

hooks.name: Price Reveal
hooks.template: I charge {price} for {deliverable}. Here is how I got there.
hooks.example: I charge $1,500 for a landing page. Here is how I got there.
hooks.best_for: Money posts get read. Only use a price you charge.
hooks.trap: Posting a price you do not actually charge.

hooks.name: Quiet Rule
hooks.example: The rule I follow: no call without a written brief first.
hooks.trap: A rule you do not follow.

hooks.name: Before You
hooks.example: Before you send that proposal, read it as the client.
hooks.trap: Telling people what to do with no credentials.

hooks.name: Small Win
hooks.example: First reply from a founder today. I referenced his pricing page.
hooks.best_for: A small account's best format: honest and specific.

hooks.name: Teardown
hooks.example: I read 20 freelance proposals. 17 opened with the writer's bio.
hooks.best_for: Original analysis. Counts as original content.
hooks.trap: Not doing the work and implying you did.

hooks.name: Unpopular Fact
hooks.example: Most of my leads came from replies, not posts. People saw me before they saw my profile.
hooks.best_for: Surprising, sourced from your own account.
hooks.trap: A fact you cannot back with your own numbers.

hooks.name: Hot Take Pair
hooks.example: Posting is easy. Replying well is hard.
hooks.best_for: Short, quotable, invites a quote post.

hooks.name: Build Log
hooks.example: Day 12 of the newsletter: 41 subscribers, 9 from replies.

hooks.name: Reader Callout
hooks.example: If you freelance and hate invoicing, send them before the final file.
hooks.trap: A situation so broad it fits everyone.

hooks.name: Quote Frame
hooks.template: "{Short line}" - {who said it}. {Why it matters now}.
hooks.example: "Do not ask for feedback, ask for a decision." My best client said that. It changed my calls.
hooks.best_for: Borrowed authority with your own application.
hooks.trap: A famous quote with no application.

hooks.name: Reversal
hooks.template: I used to {old belief}. Now I {new behaviour}.
hooks.example: I used to reply with advice. Now I reply with a question.
hooks.best_for: Shows a changed mind, which reads as honest.
hooks.trap: No clear reason for the change.
